title: Evrenin Sınırında
author: Buse Kudun
description: After escaping the bleak years of her orphanage life, Luna survives by stealing on the streets of Istanbul—until a luminous ring awakens memories of a lost family and a home she never knew she had. When Afel, a soldier from another universe wearing the same ring, appears in her house, an ancient prophecy begins to unfold: five rings must unite, divine beings must be faced, and a curse waits at the end. Searching for the bearer of the third ring, Luna and Afel are drawn into a medieval island kingdom where witchcraft is forbidden, forced to hide their identities while hunting the silver rings.
